summary: The Null Horizon is the conceptual edge of existence within the Void. Echoes fade, memories dissolve, and nonspace rifts open into unrealized timelines.
history: Formed when the Void’s outer boundary collapsed inward.
Echoes of past realities drift across the horizon.
Nonspace rifts emerged where existence thins.
The Horizon Unmade arose as the guardian of the edge of reality.
